items.text: Phase 0: capture byte-identical-JSON baseline — golden test over 3 representative snapshots (lit-card, unmeasured, intra-hub), record + commit sha256 + raw JSON; fix any non-determinism (sort before serialize)

Phase 2: move pure primitives+folds — HolderRow{hub_id,agent_id,region}; bucket_by/distinct_count_by combinators; build_felt_status/floor_for_tier verbatim; rewrite intra_hub_peers as combinator composition; extract stewarding_hubs + regional_distribution (preserve null-hub→unknown); move the 10 felt_status_tests; gate = cargo test -p elohim-facings green

Phase 3: rewire household_resilience.rs snapshot()+compute() as thin adapters with UNCHANGED signatures calling elohim_facings::*; loaders stay storage-side (take &conn); gate = cargo build -p elohim-storage
Phase 4: VERIFY cutover — 33 tests/household_resilience green + 10 felt_status_tests green + schema_contract green + byte-identical JSON (same 3 sha256) + fmt/clippy(new crate)/cargo deny
Phase 5: land+handoff — CLAUDE.md notes (storage + new elohim-facings); commit on branch; flip facings gap-item #12 CLAIMED; hand off the 4 lens charters to parallel sessions
